where: The Old Light, floor 1 — The Lobby of Groaners (Pearlmoor's joke-tower)
mood: Punchwheel's Patter — a cheeky music-hall march with brass pah-stabs and a slide-trombone laugh at every phrase end.
_note: Matches the classic oldlight-f1: 126 BPM, 4/4 march, F major. The laugh is instrumental: a slide-trombone 'wah-wah-wah' and a slide-whistle, then a rimshot ba-dum-tss with a bell ding. Opening shape: a bold brass call over the oom-pah pickup (the theme from bar one).
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
oom-pah tuba bass and brass pah-stabs on the offbeats
honky slide-trombone laugh figure and a slide whistle at phrase ends
snare rimshot ba-dum-tss with a little bell ding
comic, bouncy, warm, a lamplit old theatre lobby
strong singable melody, instantly hummable and pleasant on repeat

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {the house band strikes up at once: a bold muted-trumpet call over an oom-pah tuba pickup, a rimshot, and straight into the march}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the cheeky march tune on muted trumpet over oom-pah tuba and brass pah-stabs; every fourth bar the tune stops and a slide-trombone laughs wah-wah-wah, then a rimshot ba-dum-tss and a bell ding}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the march again with clarinet doubling an octave up and a glockenspiel counter-line; the trombone laughs answer a beat louder; the oom-pah keeps bouncing all the way through}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a sly tiptoe in B-flat major, pizzicato and bassoon creeping on staccato, a slide whistle swooping up, then a drum roll hops home}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the march returns full band in F major with its trombone laughs; the last bar's rimshot leads straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
